# WarCraft III: Reforged - Patch 2.0.4

## **Matchmaking**

- Unlocked matchmaking in 3v3 and 4v4 for Arranged and Random teams.
- Arranged Teams in all game modes have a small MMR weight applied when searching.
- Players are now able to queue in 3v3 and 4v4 in Arranged Teams smaller than the game mode.
  - For example, you will be able to queue into 3v3 as an Arranged Team of 2\.
- Leaderboard now supports smaller arranged teams in their respective game mode.
  - For example, an arranged team of 2 can now appear in the 3v3 AT leaderboard.
- Players in an Arranged Team are now prompted by a Ready Up message before queuing.

  ## **Performance**

- Improvements and optimizations have been made to the Lua garbage collector.

  ## **World Editor**

- Users are now able to add additional cliff types.
- Fixed a issue where imported tilesets would crash the editor.
- Using % characters in Lua script will no longer crash the World Editor.

  ## **Balance**

  ### **Human**

- **![Nerf][image1]** [Rifleman](https://liquipedia.net/warcraft/Rifleman) attack cooldown increased from 1.35 to 1.4.
- ![Buff][image2] [Sorceress](https://liquipedia.net/warcraft/Sorceress) Master Training research time reduced from 75 to 60 seconds.
- ![Buff][image3] [Priest](https://liquipedia.net/warcraft/Priest) Master Training research time reduced from 75 to 60 seconds.
- ![Nerf][image4] [Level 2 Water Elemental](<https://liquipedia.net/warcraft/Water_Elemental_(Level_2)>) base damage from 31 to 30\.

  ### **Orc**

- **![Buff][image5]** [Shaman](https://liquipedia.net/warcraft/Shaman) Master Training research time from 75 to 60 seconds.
- ![Buff][image6] [Witch Doctor](https://liquipedia.net/warcraft/Witch_Doctor) Master Training research time from 75 to 60 seconds.
- ![Buff][image7] [Spirit Walker](https://liquipedia.net/warcraft/Spirit_Walker) Master Training research time from 65 to 60 seconds.
- ![Buff][image8] [Healing Salve](https://liquipedia.net/warcraft/Healing_Salve) duration from 45 to 40 seconds. Amount healed is unchanged.

  ### **Undead**

- **![Buff][image9]** [Ghoul](https://liquipedia.net/warcraft/Ghoul) base damage from 9 to 10\.
- ![Nerf][image10] [Ghoul](https://liquipedia.net/warcraft/Ghoul) attack cooldown from 1.3 to 1.35.
- ![Neutral][image11] [Banshee](https://liquipedia.net/warcraft/Banshee) [Possession](https://liquipedia.net/warcraft/Possession) now has a new VFX when channeling.
- ![Neutral][image12] [Banshee](https://liquipedia.net/warcraft/Banshee) [Possession](https://liquipedia.net/warcraft/Possession) Caster and Target VFX have been adjusted so they appear above health bars.
- ![Buff][image13] [Banshee](https://liquipedia.net/warcraft/Banshee) Master Training research time from 75 to 60 seconds.
- ![Buff][image14] [Wand of Negation](https://liquipedia.net/warcraft/Wand_of_Negation) cost from 150 to 120\.
- ![Nerf][image15] [Wand of Negation](https://liquipedia.net/warcraft/Wand_of_Negation) charges from 4 to 3\.
- ![Nerf][image16] [Wand of Negation](https://liquipedia.net/warcraft/Wand_of_Negation) now has a 5 second cooldown.
- ![Buff][image17] [Frost Wyrm](https://liquipedia.net/warcraft/Frost_Wyrm) build time from 65 to 60 seconds.
- ![Buff][image18] [Frost Wyrm](https://liquipedia.net/warcraft/Frost_Wyrm) [Frost Attack](https://liquipedia.net/warcraft/Frost_Attack) duration increased from 10(3) to 10(4). (This was a previously documented change in patch 1.36.2 that was never implemented.)

  ### **Night Elf**

- **![Buff][image19]** [Druid of the Talon](https://liquipedia.net/warcraft/Druid_of_the_Talon) Master Training research time from 75 to 60 seconds.
- ![Buff][image20] [Glaive Thrower](https://liquipedia.net/warcraft/Glaive_Thrower) build time from 48 to 42 seconds.

  ### **Neutral**

- **![Nerf][image21]** [Abolish Magic](https://liquipedia.net/warcraft/Abolish_Magic) damage from 250 to 150\.
- ![Nerf][image22] [Troll Shadow Priest](https://liquipedia.net/warcraft/Forest_Troll_Shadow_Priest) stock delay from 120 to 180\.
- ![Buff][image23] [Brewmaster](https://liquipedia.net/warcraft/Pandaren_Brewmaster) [Breath of Fire](https://liquipedia.net/warcraft/Breath_of_Fire) initial area of effect from 60/60/60 to 90/90/90.
- ![Buff][image24] [Beastmaster](https://liquipedia.net/warcraft/Beastmaster) starting strength from 22 to 24\.
- ![Buff][image25] [Tinker](https://liquipedia.net/warcraft/Tinker) starting strength from 20 to 22\.
- ![Buff][image26] [Pit Lord](https://liquipedia.net/warcraft/Pit_Lord) starting strength from 26 to 28\.
- ![Nerf][image27] [Dark Ranger](https://liquipedia.net/warcraft/Dark_Ranger) [Life Drain](https://liquipedia.net/warcraft/Life_Drain) mana cost from 25/25/25 to 30/30/30.
- ![Buff][image28] [Dark Ranger](https://liquipedia.net/warcraft/Dark_Ranger) [Life Drain](https://liquipedia.net/warcraft/Life_Drain) cast range from 500/500/500 to 600/600/600.
- ![Nerf][image29] [Dark Ranger](https://liquipedia.net/warcraft/Dark_Ranger) [Life Drain](https://liquipedia.net/warcraft/Life_Drain) tether range from 800/800/800 to 700/700/700.
  - Cast range and tether range have been changed to match Siphon Mana.

  ## **Bug Fixes**

- Fixed a crash that could occur when creating an invalid UberSplat.
- Fixed a crash that would sometimes occur when loading a sound file from a Lua script.
- Fixed several bugs that, in some cases, caused memory to become corrupted, which would then lead to potential random crashes later in the game.
- Fixed an issue where Mouse Buttons were issuing incorrect commands when hovering over the UI.
- Heroes in the Warchasers custom map now have inventory slots.

# WarCraft III: Reforged - Patch 2.0.4.23727

- Fixed an issue with transparent cliffs and the replace cliffs dialog.
- Fixed a crash that would occasionally happen when loading a Texture.
- Fixed a compatibility issue when trying to launch different versions of the World Editor.
- Fixed an issue where fog of war could be seen through by queueing multiple attack actions.
